reason: The zoo is free and that's where we go on Saturdays, so paying $14 a kid every weekend is hard to justify. I'd maybe use the free first visit, but I wouldn't count on paying after that.
objection: Saturdays are going to be packed with bigger kids, and I don't trust a cap of 25 to keep them from running into my baby, even with a gated nook.
would_change_my_mind: A quiet, separate under-2 time slot on Saturdays or a way to book a spot with a small capped group, so I know the baby won't get run over.
